title: Caffeine & Blood Pressure — DOE
summary: Used statistical analysis to investigate factors associated with blood pressure.
challenge: Evaluate relationships using a structured experimental-analysis approach.
approach: Applied two-way ANOVA in an academic study of caffeine and blood pressure.
outcome: A reported p-value of 0.027 should be checked against the original analysis before external publication.
learned: Statistical significance must be interpreted alongside assumptions and study design.
